justification: Each excluded method wraps exactly one call that cannot run unattended in an automated test: a blocking modal Win32 dialog (dialog.ShowDialog), the WinForms message loop (Application.Run), the DPI/visual-style initializer that the runtime only permits calling once per process before the first window handle exists (ApplicationConfiguration.Initialize), or a real modal MessageBox. In every case the surrounding logic is exercised by tests through a matching test seam (FolderBrowserDialogProvider, OpenFileDialogProvider, ApplicationRunProvider, ApplicationConfigurationInitializer, MessageProvider), and the excluded method is only the real fallback used when no seam is installed.
